description_en: Queries the deduplicated statistics information of SQL statements that meet the specified conditional retrieve in an AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition (3.0) cluster across dimensions such as resource groups, database names, usernames, and access source addresses
description_zh: 查看AnalyticDB MySQL湖仓版（3.0）集群符合指定检索条件的SQL在资源组、数据库名、用户名以及访问源地址等维度下的去重统计信息
name: DescribeDiagnosisDimensions

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition (3.0) clusters in the specified region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL湖仓版（3.0）集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query. Specify the time as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
You can only query data from the last 14 days. If you query data from more than 14 days ago, an empty result is returned
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位：毫秒。
仅支持查看最近14天的数据，查询超过14天前的数据返回结果为空
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query. Specify the time as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

The end time must be later than the start time.
The interval between the start time and the end time cannot exceed 24 hours
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位：毫秒。

查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间。
开始时间与结束时间的间隔不能超过24小时
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html operation to query the region ID of the specified AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition (3.0) cluster
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html接口查看指定AnalyticDB MySQL湖仓版（3.0）集群的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The search conditions for SQL queries. The value is a JSON string that contains fields such as `Type`, `Value`, `Min`, and `Max`. The `Type` field specifies the query dimension. Valid values: `maxCost`, `status`, and `cost`. The `Value`, `Min`, or `Max` field specifies the query range for the dimension. Valid values:
`{"Type":"maxCost","Value":"100"}`: queries the details of the top 100 SQL statements with the longest execution duration. Currently, you can only set `Value` to 100.
`{"Type":"status","Value":"finished"}`: queries the details of completed SQL statements. You can also set `Value` to `running` or `failed` to query the details of running or failed SQL statements.
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"10","Max":"200"}`: queries the details of SQL statements whose execution duration is between 10 milliseconds and 200 milliseconds. You can also customize the minimum and maximum execution duration in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh:
SQL查询的条件，格式为JOSN字符串，包含`Type`、`Value`、`Min`或`Max`等字段。其中`Type` 表示查询维度（当前仅支持3个取值：`maxCost`、`status`和`cost`）；`Value`、`Min`或`Max`表示该维度下的查询范围。取值说明：
` {"Type":"maxCost","Value":"100"}`：表示查看执行耗时最长的前100条SQL详情，当前`Value`的取值仅支持设置为100。
`{"Type":"status","Value":"finished"}`：表示查看已完成的SQL详情。您也可以将`Value`设置为`running`或`failed`来查询正在执行或执行失败的SQL详情。
`{"Type":"cost","Min":"10","Max":"200"}`：表示查看执行耗时为10毫秒~200毫秒的SQL详情，您也可以自定义执行耗时的最大值与最小值，单位：毫秒（ms）
parameters.name: query_condition

parameters.help_en:
The language configuration. Valid values:
zh-CN: Simplified Chinese (default).
en-US: English.
ja: Japanese
parameters.help_zh:
语言配置，取值说明：
zh-CN：简体中文（默认语言）。
en-US：英文。
ja：日文
parameters.name: lang
